app.title: Whip Clothing Tool
app.subtitle: Export GTA V clothing previews and prop models for FiveM (WHIP).

paths.gtavLegacyHint: Required for vanilla extraction (folder containing GTA5.exe and update/x64).
paths.addonFoldersHint: One or more folders that contain clothing .ydd/.ytd files (e.g. resources/[clothing]/...).

previews.title: Previews (shop images)
previews.transparentNote: Background is always transparent when the format supports it (PNG/WebP).

models.title: Prop models (drop / throw)
models.note: Exports .ydr + .ytd to the chosen folder. Collision export is shown if supported by the pipeline.

collisions.label: Export collisions when available
collisions.hint: If your workflow provides .ybn/collision data, include it in the output folder. If not available, items may behave incorrectly in-game.

status.missingPython: Python not detected. Install Python 3.10+ or use the installer bundle.
status.missingGtav: Select your GTA V Legacy folder for vanilla sources.

footer.repoNote: Private GitHub repo recommended. Do not commit local paths or secrets.
